NE-senate.statusNote: Sen. Pete Ricketts (R) faces independent union leader Dan Osborn, who qualified for the November ballot by petition.

candidates.name: Pete Ricketts
candidates.background: U.S. Senator since 2023 (appointed, then elected in a 2024 special); Governor of Nebraska 2015–2023; former TD Ameritrade executive.

taxes.label: As governor: $408M property-tax relief, cut state spending growth 6.5%→0.6% (Ballotpedia)

repro.label: Moved to end Title X funds for abortion providers; signed pro-life legislation as governor (Ballotpedia)

health.label: Opposed the ACA Medicaid expansion in Nebraska; ran Medicaid through a privatized managed-care model as governor (Wikipedia)

immigration.label: 'Voted to deliver $46.5 billion investment in border security,' 16,000 new Border Patrol agents (Pete Ricketts for Senate)

climate.label: Opposed the Clean Power Plan, backed Keystone XL, called Biden's 30x30 conservation plan a 'radical climate agenda' (Wikipedia)

education.label: Backs tax-credit vouchers subsidizing private schools and charter authorization; longtime private-scholarship funder (OnTheIssues)

safety.label: 'Fought against calls to defund the police'; co-sponsored harsher penalties for criminals targeting officers; $47.7M law-enforcement training center (Pete Ricketts for Senate)

democracy.label: Gave $100,000 to the 2022 photo voter ID initiative and campaigned for it: showing ID 'strengthens the integrity of our elections' (Ballotpedia)

nullNotes.cost: checked petericketts.com cutting-taxes page (frames affordability purely as tax relief, already scored under taxes) and Ballotpedia, no distinct cost-of-living approach documented
nullNotes.housing: checked petericketts.com, Ballotpedia, and Wikipedia, nothing documented

candidates.name: Dan Osborn
candidates.background: Industrial mechanic and Navy veteran who led the 2021 Kellogg's strike in Omaha; ran a close independent race in 2024, running again in 2026. Petitioned onto the November ballot.

cost.label: Raise the federal minimum wage; cut taxes on overtime and small business; right-to-repair (Wikipedia)

immigration.label: Mixed: supports the border wall and security, and legalizing long-term non-criminal undocumented workers (Wikipedia)

taxes.label: Raise Social Security cap on high earners; criticizes 'tax cuts for the billionaires'; cut small-business taxes (Wikipedia)

repro.label: Personally pro-life, opposes a national ban; backs access within Roe limits, opposes late-term abortion (Wikipedia)

health.label: Give Medicaid 'full authority to negotiate drug prices directly'; opposes VA privatization and Medicaid cuts hitting rural hospitals; Break Up Big Medicine Act (Osborn for Senate)

democracy.label: Calls the SAVE Act proof-of-citizenship voting bill 'unconstitutional': 'Essentially, it's going to be a poll tax' (Breitbart)
